approach: Add one module, crates/athena-core/src/iris.rs. It parses the committed spend ledger docs/iris-ledger.toml (integer cents, no entries yet, only the keys date, cents and note) and has a pure guard, check_generation(entries, proposed_cents). The guard refuses when the lifetime total plus the proposed cost would exceed 1500 cents; exactly 1500 is allowed. Export the module from lib.rs. In docs/spec.toml, replace OLY-B-SET-04's mechanism "none" with text naming iris.rs, the ledger and the existing prose reference to the harness-engineering bundle, and set the measure to "...; status: not shown" naming the tests. Add a hestia.rs unit test that parses the real docs/spec.toml via include_str!, shows OLY-B-SET-04 is absent from spec_gaps, and shows the same entry with mechanism "none" is a gap. Add a CHANGELOG entry. Nothing calls the guard from a real Iris client, because none exists and calling Iris is out of scope. The guard is the check a future generation path must call.

decisions.choice: The cap is a Rust constant LIFETIME_CAP_CENTS = 1500, not a ledger field.
decisions.reason: The ledger is data a job could edit. A cap in the same file could be raised along with the spend. The constant sits in code that the check and test gates cover. The ledger stays amounts only.

rejected.why: A single edit to the data file could lift the cap.
athena.toml is governance and is not a deliverable (out of scope).

decisions.choice: Integer cents (u64) with saturating addition; a proposed cost of 0 is allowed; a total over 1500 is refused.
decisions.reason: Integer cents avoid float error at the exact-1500 boundary. Saturating addition means a huge proposed cost is refused and cannot wrap.

rejected.why: Rounding at the boundary makes the exactly-$15 case unreliable.

decisions.choice: parse_ledger uses toml_edit, already a dependency of athena-core (crates/athena-core/Cargo.toml:26). It accepts only the top-level key `entry`, and in each entry only date, cents and note. Any other key, or a negative or non-integer cents value, is an error.
decisions.reason: This makes 'no credential-like fields' a property of the parser, so the test on the committed file shows it. A planted api_key field is refused, which demonstrates the check.

rejected.why: A blocklist misses new names. The allow-list does not.

rejected.option: add the toml crate to athena-core
rejected.why: New dependency; toml_edit already does the job.

decisions.choice: The ledger test reads the file with include_str!("../../../docs/iris-ledger.toml") inside iris.rs, the same relative path that hestia.rs:4287 uses for docs/spec.toml.
decisions.reason: The path is proven to work from crates/athena-core/src. The build fails if the committed ledger is missing.

rejected.why: Depends on the working directory; model_roster.rs needs CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR gymnastics for the same thing.

decisions.choice: The 'harness-engineering bundle as a reference' half is prose only. The mechanism text points to the existing README.md Attribution section and docs/design/athena-v0.md section 15 (requirements-map.md:114 marks it Covered). No new code or doc is added for it.
decisions.reason: The brief says to use the bundle as a reference, which is not machine-checkable. Small change: one module, one ledger, one spec entry.

rejected.option: a new doc or check for the reference half
rejected.why: It adds files outside the deliverables and checks nothing the owner asked to enforce.

decisions.choice: Measure ends in `status: not shown` and names `cargo test -p athena-core iris` and `cargo test -p athena-core hestia`.
decisions.reason: None of the STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS (status.rs:305-321) prints Iris spend, and `athena status` does not show it. The `requirement` label (spec gaps) would only measure the gap list. The label `not shown` is accepted by measure_problem (hestia.rs:1229).

rejected.why: It says the requirement is shown in the spec gap list, not that the budget is enforced.

rejected.option: add a new `athena status` section for Iris spend
rejected.why: Changes the status view and its label table; larger than this request.

files.purpose: Ledger parser, LIFETIME_CAP_CENTS = 1500, spent_cents, check_generation and its tests.
Add `pub mod iris;` (between `invocation` and `jev`) and one bullet in the Modules doc.
Committed Iris spend ledger: header comments (cap, units, entry shape, no credentials) and zero entries.
OLY-B-SET-04: real mechanism and a measure ending in `status: not shown`; owner stays Athena.
Add a unit test that the real spec's OLY-B-SET-04 is not a spec gap, and is one with mechanism none.
Add an Unreleased/Added bullet for the Iris budget guard, in the style of the OLY-B-SET-02 bullet.

steps: Read crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs header and one small test module for style; confirm `cargo test -p athena-core iris` will match module iris::tests.

Create crates/athena-core/src/iris.rs. Module doc: what the guard is, the ledger path, that Iris calls and credentials are out of scope, and that the harness-engineering reference is prose (README.md Attribution, docs/design/athena-v0.md section 15). Items: `pub const LEDGER_FILE: &str = "docs/iris-ledger.toml"`; `pub const LIFETIME_CAP_CENTS: u64 = 1500`; `#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)] pub struct LedgerEntry { pub date: String, pub cents: u64, pub note: String }`; `#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)] pub struct BudgetRefusal { pub spent_cents, pub proposed_cents, pub cap_cents }` with Display and std::error::Error via thiserror (a workspace dependency of core); `pub fn parse_ledger(text: &str) -> anyhow::Result<Vec<LedgerEntry>>` using toml_edit: top-level keys other than `entry` are an error, entry keys other than date/cents/note are an error, `cents` must be a non-negative integer, `date` a string; no `entry` table gives an empty list; `pub fn spent_cents(entries: &[LedgerEntry]) -> u64` (saturating sum); `pub fn check_generation(entries, proposed_cents) -> Result<(), BudgetRefusal>` calling `check_against(entries, proposed_cents, LIFETIME_CAP_CENTS)`, which refuses when `spent.saturating_add(proposed) > cap`.

In iris.rs add `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` with the cases in criteria 2 and 3: over, at and under budget over several entries; u64::MAX; empty ledger; committed ledger within budget; credential, token, negative-cents and string-cents inputs refused; plus iris_spec_entry_names_files_that_exist (criterion 1).

Create docs/iris-ledger.toml: comment header only (cap is 1500 cents in iris.rs; amounts in whole cents; each spend is a `[[entry]]` with date, cents, note; no credentials, keys or account data; append an entry only after a generation is allowed by the guard) and zero entries. Keep it free of email-like text and key-like strings.
Edit crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs: add `pub mod iris;` after `pub mod invocation;` and a Modules bullet for [`iris`].

Edit docs/spec.toml lines 2051 and 2053 only: mechanism = a sentence naming crates/athena-core/src/iris.rs (`check_generation`) and docs/iris-ledger.toml, with the prose-only reference in README.md Attribution and docs/design/athena-v0.md section 15; measure = "cargo test -p athena-core iris shows over, at and under budget and the committed ledger; cargo test -p athena-core hestia shows the spec gap is gone; status: not shown". Keep owner = "Athena". Do not touch the statement, kind, status or sources.
Add to hestia.rs tests, after the real-spec test at ~4312, `oly_b_set_04_no_longer_appears_in_the_spec_gap_list` (criterion 4).

Add the CHANGELOG.md bullet at the top of [Unreleased] / Added: OLY-B-SET-04 now has a mechanism, naming `check_generation`, the 1500-cent cap, the ledger, that no generation path calls it yet, the measure `status: not shown`, and the test commands.
Run cargo fmt --all, then the three checks, plus `cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus` and `cargo test -p xtask`; fix any clippy finding in the new code.

risks.risk: The guard is not yet called by any generation path, because no Iris client exists, so the requirement is met by a checked-in guard and not by a live gate.
risks.mitigation: The mechanism text and the changelog say so plainly. Out of scope: calling Iris. The measure is `status: not shown` and names the tests. This follows the OLY-A-12 entry, which also says it is not yet called (CHANGELOG.md:21-26).

risks.risk: The cap could be edited in code or the ledger edited to hide spend.
risks.mitigation: The cap is a constant in code that every job passes through review, tests and the verifier. The ledger is committed, so edits are visible in history. The parser rejects unknown fields.

risks.risk: The include_str! path to docs/iris-ledger.toml breaks the build if the file moves.
risks.mitigation: It uses the same relative form as hestia.rs:4287. A missing file is a compile error, which makes the test fail without the ledger.

risks.risk: A test name or filter mismatch: `cargo test -p athena-core iris` matches test names or module paths containing `iris`.
risks.mitigation: All new tests live in module iris::tests, so the filter matches them. The spec test in hestia uses a name starting oly_b_set_04 and is run by path hestia::tests::oly_b_set_04.

risks.risk: The CHANGELOG.md is 433 KB; an edit needs care to land under [Unreleased] / Added.
risks.mitigation: Insert the new bullet at the top of the Added list, after line 10, with the same hanging indent as its neighbours.

demonstrations.method: A unit test in iris.rs (iris_spec_entry_names_files_that_exist) reads docs/spec.toml with include_str!, cuts the OLY-B-SET-04 entry, and checks the mechanism is not "none", names crates/athena-core/src/iris.rs and docs/iris-ledger.toml, owner = "Athena" is present, and the measure line ends in `status: not shown` and contains `cargo test -p athena-core iris`. It also checks that the two named files exist, using Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")). The verifier may also Grep docs/spec.toml and run ls on the two paths.
demonstrations.command: cargo test -p athena-core iris_spec_entry && cargo test -p athena-core hestia::tests::oly_b_set_04
demonstrations.observes: The test passes. Grep shows mechanism, owner and measure lines for OLY-B-SET-04. Both files are listed by ls.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the entry's mechanism still "none", or with the files missing, the assertions on the mechanism text and on file existence fail.
demonstrations.seam: The test calls the entry-cutting pattern of crates/athena-core/tests/model_roster.rs:51-68 (exists, read) and include_str! as at hestia.rs:4287 (exists). It uses the committed files and no fake. Step 4 adds the test.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests in iris.rs call the production check_generation(&entries, proposed_cents) on in-memory entries parsed through parse_ledger from small TOML strings. Cases: (a) 1400 spent + 101 proposed (1501) is refused, and the refusal reports spent, proposed and cap; (b) 1400 + 100 (exactly 1500) is allowed; (c) 0 spent + 1500 is allowed; (d) 0 spent + 1501 is refused; (e) 800 + 700 is allowed and 800 + 701 is refused over two entries; (f) u64::MAX proposed is refused with no overflow panic; (g) an empty ledger allows a small cost. Test (a) also asserts that the same input would be Ok if the cap constant were larger, by calling an inner helper with an explicit cap (check_against(entries, proposed, cap)), so the test shows the allowed case with the same input and no protection, then the refusal with the protection.
demonstrations.observes: All tests pass: refusal over budget, allow at and under budget.
demonstrations.fails_without: If check_generation always returns Ok, tests (a), (d), (e) and (f) fail. If the comparison is `>=` instead of `>`, tests (b) and (c) fail.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points parse_ledger and check_generation, both pub, added in step 2. The fixtures are TOML string literals in the tests. No fake is used, and the logic under test is not in the test.

demonstrations.method: Test committed_ledger_parses_and_is_within_budget: parse_ledger(include_str!("../../../docs/iris-ledger.toml")) must be Ok, spent_cents(&entries) <= LIFETIME_CAP_CENTS, and every entry has only date, cents and note. A second test, a_credential_field_is_refused, feeds parse_ledger an entry with `api_key = "x"`, a top-level `token = "x"` key, a negative cents value and a string cents value, and asserts each is an Err. Together they show that the committed file has no credential-like field and that the parser would refuse one.
demonstrations.observes: The tests pass. The committed ledger parses with zero entries and total 0.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the parser skipped unknown keys, a_credential_field_is_refused fails. If the ledger file is missing, the crate does not compile (include_str!).
demonstrations.seam: parse_ledger (step 2). The committed docs/iris-ledger.toml is the fixture (step 3). Planted bad TOML strings in the tests are the negative cases. No double.

demonstrations.method: New hestia.rs test oly_b_set_04_no_longer_appears_in_the_spec_gap_list, next to the real-spec test at hestia.rs:4285-4312. It calls parse_spec(include_str!("../../../docs/spec.toml")), then spec_gaps(&requirements), and asserts no gap has id OLY-B-SET-04. It then clones that requirement, sets mechanism = "none", and asserts spec_gaps returns one gap with no_mechanism true (the protection removed gives the gap). It also asserts measure_problem(&r.measure) is None. The rest of the spec is not asserted to be clean, so unrelated gaps cannot fail this test.
demonstrations.observes: Passes: the real entry yields no gap and the 'none' variant yields a gap.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the mechanism still "none", spec_gaps returns a gap for OLY-B-SET-04 and the first assertion fails.
demonstrations.seam: Production parse_spec and spec_gaps (hestia.rs:1172, 1291; exist). The fixture is the committed docs/spec.toml, plus an in-memory clone with the mechanism set to none. Step 5 adds the test. The existing test the_real_spec_records_every_field (4286) already runs measure_problem over every active requirement.
